items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Leroy Smith, as far as I know he was an eastern black.

ctx.x: And she still had the same authentic diamonds that she always had. They didn't find her washing dishes at Macy's. And Butterbeans and Susie, when they bought their home in Chicago anyone could come to that, anyone who was in the profession. When Miss Ethel Waters, before she went into "As Thousands Cheer" to tour all over, when she came out with the great bandleader Leroy Smith, when she had that show she didn't have no money -
